$comment: Advisory payload bands from docs/full-rewrite-design-2026-07-18.md §2.1, measured in Brotli KB by scripts/ci/bundle-budget.ts. GitHub workflows report these values but do not gate merges or deployments.

notes.platform_shell_eager_js: Sum of brotli sizes of entry (isEntry) JS chunks — the code parsed before interactivity on the feed shell.
notes.platform_eager_css: Sum of brotli sizes of the render-blocking CSS on a site page: CSS emitted for entry chunks plus the site-tier entry sheet (app/site-tier.css) that __root.tsx links through a ?url import.
notes.total_client_js_warn: Whole client JS surface across all lazy chunks; informational drift signal, not a per-page cost.
